alternation.note: the two directions alternate in blocks of two days along the record, so the orbit contrast is a trailing-window difference and not a paired test
alternation.rule: one orbit direction per acquisition day, in alternating blocks of two days, so no acquisition day carries both a usable ascending and a usable descending echo and a per-day orbit difference does not exist

axis.definition: the acquisition day, one dot per echo-bearing chip; each dot carries a sub-day offset of 0.18 d by direction, and no day carries chips of both directions
axis.name: acquisition_day
axis.note: the event falls inside a drawn 14-day step, so the two stretches meet at a band and not at a point

covariates.note: what else moves with the pass geometry: the per-orbit medians of the export's co-variates. Ascending passes are the 15:2x and 17:2x UT ones, descending the 05:2x UT ones, so temperature, wind and intensity move with the orbit by construction — they would have to be held fixed before an orbit split of the mask channels meant anything physical

bootstrap.note: the paper result's own n_boot and rng_seed, re-derived here so every CI of this figure is reproducible
bootstrap.statistic: median(DESC) - median(ASC), each orbit resampled independently

difference.confound: the record's four post-event echo chips are two ascending and two descending passes, so the pre-only column drops a balanced pair: the pooled difference and the before-the-collapse difference differ by those four chips alone, and printing both shows how little of the pooled number is state
difference.definition: delta_orbit = median(DESC) - median(ASC) over the echo-bearing chips
difference.note: median(DESC) - median(ASC) over the echo-bearing chips: a descriptive pass-geometry difference, never a damage or orbit verdict. The two orbits are disjoint sets of acquisition days, so the chips are not paired and no causal reading is available

difference.sign: positive means the descending passes read higher on that channel; Cliff's delta is called with the ascending chips as reference, which gives the identical sign

chain.note: the export's own orbit_direction and pass_label agree with the measurement extract and with the resolved bursts on every chip; the cross-layer pins carry the three disagreement counts, all 0

orbits.geometry_sentence: the record's passes are ASC is IW1/IW3 on relative orbit 15 + 88 (15:2x + 17:2x UT, VV x 33 + VH x 29); DESC is IW1/IW3 on relative orbit 37 + 139 (05:2x UT, VH x 31 + VV x 27)
orbits.note: both directions straddle the collapse date and the four post-event echo chips are two ascending and two descending passes: this block describes where the echoes sit over the four pass geometries, it is not an orbit contrast of the states

panels.floor_ticks: the 54 echo-free chips: no ordinate on any channel, drawn on the panel floor
panels.g: the pooled difference beside the pre-only one, each with its seeded 95% CI, a star for a CI that excludes zero
panels.h: the 120 chips per direction and state, split into their echo-bearing and echo-free parts, with both Fisher tests printed

provenance.note: the nine committed inputs, by content; the same digests the analysis reference names, re-read here and pinned

role: companion: delta_orbit = median(DESC) - median(ASC) per channel, pooled and as a trailing-window series, with the pass geometry, the coverage of the two directions and the co-variate controls; it adds no number to the A-E pin contract of fig_haltern_ocv_paper.py

series.join_rule: a line is drawn only between two consecutive points one cadence step (6 d) apart; every longer step of the series is left open
series.no_interpolation: a day whose window holds fewer than 2 chips of either orbit keeps no point, and no value is interpolated across a hole
series.note: every kept day is pre-event: the record's single post-event echo chip has no descending chip in its own window

site: Haltern AV9 Wind Park (Kreis Recklinghausen, NRW)
title: HALTERN — the orbit split of the echo-mask vector: four pass geometries fall into two directions that alternate, so the split is a trailing-window difference
